title: Concept: Django Silk profiling UI in a response
description: A django-silk profiling page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Silk records every request with its SQL, its Python profile and its response, so a reachable page shows the schema and the data of any request an operator has browsed.
applicability: Deployments that render a django-silk profiling page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Silk records every request with its SQL, its Python profile and its response, so a reachable page shows the schema and the data of any request an operator has browsed.
